rules: Progression requires consolidated evidence and a completed academic period.
Elapsed time alone never advances a cadet.
Ordinary single failure cannot directly dismiss the cadet.
Dismissal requires explicit authorized dismissal basis.
Authorized leave may interrupt progression without erasing prior history.
Repeat selected modules and repeat year preserve all prior evidence/history.
At end of Year 2, Year 3 activation requires persisted specialization selection.
Player specialization choice is explicit and never inferred.
Commission, Ensign rank and first assignment are downstream of graduation/record process.
Persistent identity, relationships, mentors, discipline, social history and prior results survive year transitions.
